definitions.explanation: A state of mutual goodwill and cooperation, especially between nations, organizations, or groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友好|ゆうこう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}めたい→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
examples.english: We want to deepen the friendly relations between the two countries.

examples.japanese: {友好|ゆうこう}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれた→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
{友好|ゆうこう}⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{接|せっ}した→接する：12920_sessuru⟧。
examples.english: I treated them with a friendly attitude.

notes:
USAGE: {友好|ゆうこう} is typically used in formal contexts, especially in diplomacy and international relations. For personal friendships, ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧ is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {友好|ゆうこう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (friendly relations)
- {友好|ゆうこう}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧ (friendship treaty)
- {友好|ゆうこう}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (sister city)
- {友好|ゆうこう}⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧ (friendly - な-adjective)

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧ (valid, effective), which has the same reading.
